reviews.text: I've taken my cat to Fernando his entire life. Last month, the diagnosis was finally very bad (incurable lung tumor). Seeking a second opinion as a last hope for my cat, I took him to two veterinary hospitals. To begin with, they were outrageously expensive: one in the city center cost €205 per day, and the other on the outskirts cost €250, and most of the staff were very young (the second hospital gave me the feeling that they were charging as if it were a service with experts in the city center but offering a service with juniors on the outskirts). Well, even after I told the hospitals Fernando's diagnosis from the start, they couldn't clearly see that the main problem was a lung tumor. At the second hospital, they had to do a CT scan to realize what was really wrong. An ultrasound was enough for Fernando. Fernando is a veterinarian with years of experience. And he offers a fixed monthly plan for €14.50 that includes deworming and consultations, and discounts on vaccines, food, and more.

I've only been to him three times, but he's already struck me as an excellent professional with a lot of experience. He's one of those vets that are becoming increasingly rare.

I went with my senior dog who had a heart condition. My previous vet insisted on giving her cough syrup, even after a canine cardiologist confirmed the problem.

Some ladies from the neighborhood recommended this vet, and he immediately recognized the problem as soon as he saw my dog. That's invaluable to me.
Hello, I'm very happy with the vet; he's very attentive, kind, and a very good vet. I wanted to know if he's open these days so I can come by and pick up the deworming pill.

Fernando is the best. I took my dog ​​to him with a diagnosis that they wanted to remove all her mammary glands and empty them out. He told me it was extremely invasive and unnecessary. She had the surgery with him, and sure enough, she only had a benign nodule. She recovered incredibly well, and he was always attentive, calling us to share test results. He's the best! I also have a dachshund that he treats; he performed a cleaning on her, and she's as good as new. We trust him completely. Anyone who can go to him won't regret it.
Fernando is a true professional with a strong ethical sense. I wholeheartedly recommend him for the way he cares for my dog.

Of all the vets my dog ​​Lúa has been to—I'm talking about vets in Spain (Madrid, Mallorca, Aravaca, Jerez), several in Denmark, Romania, and Switzerland—Don Fernando is the only one where she's never aggressive, fearful, or anything like that. I'm talking about a dog who always has to wear a muzzle because she tends to be somewhat aggressive and doesn't accept strangers. However, with Fernando, I've never seen her upset or uncomfortable. She lets him do everything. Besides, wherever I call for a vet, or go to, they tell me: "Appointment." "Oh, you're here without an appointment." "You don't have an appointment?" And so on. With Fernando, that's never happened. I always call, and he always says: "Bring her here." Another thing, he always answers the phone. Many times it's busy, but he still says: "Come, bring her here," and hangs up quickly. 💐❤️

After 17 years in the industry, in my opinion, this is the best clinic in Madrid, thanks to its owner.

Honest, ethical, and professional.

He's the best vet I've ever known, always ready to help with anything you need, empathetic, and very professional. My dog ​​is 15 years old, and when I met him, I didn't hesitate to put my furry friend in his care. Thank you for everything, Fernando! Thank you so much for always being there.
Small neighborhood clinic, but very professional. Highly recommended for its service and price.
Everything was excellent, this veterinarian inspires a lot of confidence.

I always go there with complete confidence! Vaccinations, allergies! My dog ​​Gigil is sensitive to everything!
The best vet we've found in the neighborhood!

Heads up!
My parents took their dog for vaccinations, deworming, and regular gastroenteritis treatment... he also had hip pain due to his age. He's a calm and kind person, but isn't being a good doctor more important than being nice?

The dog has suffered from stomach and digestive problems for years and years.

What happened? They went on a trip. The dog got sick again. Vomiting, diarrhea... They took him to a vet where they were staying. First, he palpated his abdomen. Then he wanted to do an ultrasound... A sad and painful surprise.

The dog had a huge tumor attached to his liver... Who knows how long it had been there... And who knows if the animal's lethargy was really due to this tumor... He was given a ton of injections, pills, and canned special food... for years! My parents, with all their love, cared for the little dog, following the veterinarian's instructions without question. Looking back, they never performed a more thorough examination or a diagnostic ultrasound.

I must say, very sadly, the dog was already very ill and beyond hope of treatment, and right there, they had to euthanize him, leaving us all devastated and heartbroken. I'm not lying, nor do I intend to hurt anyone, but I must warn you and share this experience.

Excellent service and a top-notch professional. I've been seeing Fernando for years and I have complete confidence in him. He's not one of those who tries to rip you off, and he's very straightforward. Without a doubt, he's one of the best veterinarians I've ever met.
Fernando is very friendly, and he treats my dog ​​wonderfully. An excellent professional.

Excellent veterinary clinic. I finally found a place with great service, good prices, and where they don't try to force you to order x-rays or blood tests for no reason. I only trust my dog ​​to Dr. Ayala.
